competitive_share_entrants.note: Mixed picture: TI holds/extends #1 global analog share and is gaining in China near-term, but Chinese domestic vendors (SG Micro, 3Peak) are structurally eroding share in overlapping mid/low-end telecom & consumer segments, and TI's 2026 price hikes create an opening analysts flag as accelerating customer migration to local alternatives in industrial/auto.
